sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yào dìng yí ge fángjiān.
sentences.english_hint: I want to book a room.
sentences.scenario: Tell a hotel you want to make a booking.
sentences.source_note: Repeated 买酒店 errors; the analysis recommends 订酒店 or 订房间.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gēn nǚ'ér yìqǐ qù lǚyóu.
sentences.source_note: Corrects repeated placement of 跟我的女儿 after 旅游.

sentences.chinese: 比起坐飞机，我更喜欢坐高铁。
sentences.pinyin: Bǐqǐ zuò fēijī, wǒ gèng xǐhuan zuò gāotiě.
sentences.english_hint: I prefer high-speed trains to flying.
sentences.scenario: Compare your preferred ways to travel.
sentences.source_note: The learner's comparison of high-speed trains and flying was unfinished; this is the analysis correction.

sentences.chinese: 我想从北京坐高铁到上海。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng cóng Běijīng zuò gāotiě dào Shànghǎi.
sentences.english_hint: I want to take a high-speed train from Beijing to Shanghai.
sentences.scenario: Describe the train route you want to take.
sentences.source_note: The learner expressed this travel wish; the analysis supplies smoother route word order.

sentences.english_hint: The airport used to be small.
sentences.scenario: Describe the old airport before it changed.
sentences.source_note: The learner repeatedly used 以后 when describing the old airport.

sentences.pinyin: Dì yī tiān xiān qù jiǔdiàn xiūxi.
sentences.english_hint: On the first day, go to the hotel to rest first.
sentences.scenario: Explain the first step in your travel routine.
sentences.source_note: The learner described resting at the hotel after arrival and struggled to retrieve 休息.

sentences.pinyin: Dì èr tiān zài chūqù wán.
sentences.english_hint: Go out for fun the next day.
sentences.scenario: Explain what happens the day after arrival.
sentences.source_note: The analysis corrects 明天 to 第二天 for the next day in an itinerary.

sentences.scenario: Tell a hotel how long your stay will be.
sentences.source_note: The learner repeatedly said 两个天 and 三个天; the analysis gives this short practice sentence.

sentences.pinyin: Wǔ ge rén yígòng sān qiān měiyuán.
sentences.english_hint: It's three thousand dollars for all five people.
sentences.scenario: Clarify the total ticket price for your family.
sentences.source_note: The learner clarified that three thousand dollars was the total for five people.

sentences.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, tài guì le.
sentences.scenario: Explain why a travel cost does not suit your budget.
sentences.source_note: Corrects repeated use of 跟我 to mean 'for me,' including the credit-card discussion.

sentences.scenario: Answer a question about baggage allowance.
sentences.source_note: The analysis replaces the misleading 是否 transcription with 看 for 'depends.'

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bú huì yòng Zhōngwén shuō.
sentences.english_hint: I can't say it in Chinese.
sentences.scenario: Ask for help expressing an idea during your lesson.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 我不可以说……以中文的; difficulty expressing words recurred throughout the lesson.

sentences.chinese: 我没在美国以外的地方开过车。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ méi zài Měiguó yǐwài de dìfang kāi guo chē.
sentences.english_hint: I've never driven outside the United States.
sentences.scenario: Explain your driving experience when planning a trip.
sentences.source_note: The learner explicitly said they had not driven outside the United States; this is the analysis correction.

sentences.english_hint: The tickets are already sold out.
sentences.scenario: Explain why you cannot book the tickets.
sentences.source_note: The lesson taught 卖完了 for unavailable tickets; the analysis highlights 完 as completion.
